title: 机场低空安防应用
description:
机场低空安防应用
为应对无人机黑飞、恐怖袭击及非法窥探等威胁，我司研发的机场低空安全综合防控系统构建了智能化、多层次的无人机防御体系。该系统整合无线电频谱分析技术，实现机场周边3公里范围内的全天候监测，可精准区分无人机与鸟类等目标，定位飞手位置。
系统采用动态频谱管控技术，通过定向射频干扰压制无人机导航（GPS/北斗）与遥控链路，迫使其迫降或返航，同时避免干扰机场塔台通信等关键频段。配备便携式反制装备，可在跑道、航站楼等重点区域快速部署，响应迅速，形成灵活的单点防护能力。
以智能指挥平台为核心，系统实现监测数据、电子地图与应急预案的多维度融合，支持与空管、公安部门的实时联动。风险预测模型，可提前预警潜在威胁，并自动触发分级响应机制（如预警、驱离）。该系统已在杭州萧山国际机场等场景成功应用，为全球机场提供了可复用的低空安防解决方案。

description_en:
Airport Low-Altitude Security Application
To address threats such as unauthorized drone flights, terrorist attacks, and illegal snooping, our company developed a comprehensive airport low-altitude security prevention and control system that builds an intelligent, multi-layered drone defense framework. The system integrates radio spectrum analysis technology to achieve 24/7 monitoring within a 3-kilometer radius around the airport. It can accurately distinguish between targets like drones and birds, and locate the pilot's position.
The system utilizes dynamic spectrum control technology, suppressing drone navigation (GPS/BeiDou) and remote control links through directional RF interference. This forces the drone to make an emergency landing or return, while avoiding interference with critical frequency bands such as airport tower communications. Equipped with portable countermeasure gear, it can be rapidly deployed in key areas such as runways and terminals, responding swiftly to form flexible single-point protection capabilities.
Centered around an intelligent command platform, the system achieves a multi-dimensional fusion of monitoring data, electronic maps, and emergency plans, supporting real-time linkage with air traffic control and public security departments. The risk prediction model can warn of potential threats in advance and automatically trigger graded response mechanisms (e.g., early warning, expulsion). The system has been successfully applied in scenarios such as Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport, providing a reusable low-altitude security solution for airports worldwide.
